question: Which one of the following is the longest river of Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnali**__.**__​__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Karnali river is also known as river **Ghaghara**.
 
• It is a **perennial transboundary river.**
 
• It is the longest river in **Nepal**.
 
• It originates at **Mansarovar lake**.
 
• The river joins the **Sharda River **at **Brahmaghat in India. **
